### Data for the package

```{r}

load("~/Dropbox (Personal)/Artigos/2019 IJT/artigo_ijt.RData")

vars <- names(bd_artigo_itc)[c(1:197, 253, 257, 260,  293:295, 930, 931)]

sjmisc::frq(bd_artigo_itc$age1)
sjmisc::frq(bd_artigo_itc$Education)
sjmisc::frq(bd_artigo_itc$SEXO)

sjmisc::frq(bd_artigo_itc$Education)

library(dplyr)

set.seed(23)
data_senna <- bd_artigo_itc %>% select(vars) %>% sample_n(size = 2300) 

sjmisc::frq(data_senna$age1)
sjmisc::frq(data_senna$Education)
sjmisc::frq(bd_artigo_itc$SEXO)

saveRDS(data_senna, file="data_senna.RData")

names(item_diction_new2)

senna_dic <- tibble(
 coditem = item_diction_new2$codItem,
 scale = item_diction_new2$domain_final,
 pole = item_diction_new2$pole, 
 seman_pairs = item_diction_new2$pairs_final, 
 item_text = item_diction_new2$item_text,
 item_text_pt  = item_diction_new2$port_text,
 domain = item_diction_new2$domain_final,
 facet = item_diction_new2$facet_final,
 pers_selfeff = item_diction_new2$P_S
)

senna_dic %>% arrange(domain, facet, pers_selfeff, seman_pairs ) %>% View()

senna_dic %>% 
 mutate(domain = factor(domain, levels = c("O", "C", "E","A", "N"))) %>%
 arrange(domain, facet, pers_selfeff, seman_pairs ) %>%
 writexl::write_xlsx(path = "senna_dic.xlsx")

library(readxl)
senna_dic <- read_excel("senna_dic.xlsx")
saveRDS(senna_dic, "senna.dic.RDS")

View(senna_dic)


```
